title: Video Cut & Merge - Fast LVC
summary: Lossless video cutter: cut, trim & merge videos in seconds. No re-encoding!
description:
What is Lossless Video Cutter (LVC)?

Lossless Video Cutter (LVC) is an app that lets you
cut, trim, and merge videos quickly without quality loss.
Perfect for removing unwanted parts, extracting clips, or joining multiple videos into one
— all without re-encoding.


Main Features

  Lossless cutting: Trim or split videos while keeping the original quality
  Multi-Cut mode: Remove multiple unwanted segments and join the rest into one video
  Lossless merging: Join multiple videos into one without quality loss
  Ultra-fast processing: No re-encoding, minimal waiting time
  Video rotation: Rotate videos in 90-degree increments while editing
  Simple operation: Just select the range and cut, with progress display for peace of mind
  Custom file names: Choose your preferred output file name pattern
  Easy sharing: Instantly share to X (formerly Twitter), LINE, Instagram, and more


Why is it so fast?

The app processes videos based on keyframes (typically every 0.5–1 second),
allowing precise, lossless cutting and merging without re-compression.
This makes it much faster than typical video editors.


Recommended Workflow

  Use LVC to remove unwanted parts → Then add music or text with another editing app
  Quickly cut videos after shooting and share them directly on social media
  Combine separately recorded clips into a single video
  Merge multiple scenes to create a highlight reel


Supported Formats
Supports common video formats such as MP4 recorded on smartphones.
* Video merging works with videos of the same format (codec, resolution, frame rate).


Lossless = No quality loss.

Recommended for anyone who wants to edit videos quickly while keeping them clean and sharp.
